findings.issue: The SPEC-01 test checks only that every row's selected label is one of the four styles and seats/names are unchanged. That already holds before the press, so the test would pass if the button did nothing or only redrew some seats at 9 players.
findings.evidence: Before the click, all 8 rows at 9 players Mixed already show valid labels; the expect.poll at :136-145 resolves immediately for a no-op button. The press wiring is covered elsewhere: SPEC-04/05 at 6 players use the cycling 1-word stub, so extra, missing or multi-word crypto calls would shift the rows and fail there.
findings.fix: Optionally, add a pass-through init script in this test that counts 1-word Uint32Array getRandomValues calls. Assert 0 before the press and 8 after it. Or stub 8 known words and assert the exact rows. This file is locked, so the change needs the owner's unlock.

findings.issue: Words 3 and 4294967295 both map to Rock, so the unit test cannot tell seat 3 from seat 4 in the clockwise-order check.
findings.evidence: Seats 3 and 4 both expect 'Rock'. Swapping their order would still pass this test, but the SPEC-03 acceptance (words 3,2,1,0,3 -> seat 3 TAG, seat 4 Rock) catches it.
findings.fix: None needed; the spec fixes these words. Optionally add a second recording with distinct words per seat (e.g. 0,1,2,3,0 -> 6 TAG ... 3 Rock, 4 TAG).

summary: Implementation matches the spec. randomBotStyles draws one word per bot in botsClockwise order, maps it with BOT_STYLES[w % 4] (exactly uniform), and range-checks 0..2^32-1 with the specified RangeError text. It returns a frozen map with no user key and uses no crypto or DOM. configWithSeatStyles is a plain fold over configWithSeatStyle. The screen's only crypto use is a 1-word Uint32Array per bot, inside onClick, so replay 4-word counts are unaffected. setEdits replaces all edits, row edits spread on top, and preset/players changes still clear edits. The 4 Q-3 amendments each change only the button list. The e2e stub intercepts only 1-element Uint32Array calls and passes the rest through. Unit and acceptance tests (6) pass locally. The new and amended e2e specs (12 tests, Chromium and WebKit) pass. Gates fix-2 PASS: lint, typecheck, coverage and test integrity; lines 503 vs a 500 budget is a warning only. No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings.
